legalActions.narration: 10 cards dealt each. Draw from stock or discard, form melds, and discard to end your turn.

instructions: Form sets (3-4 of same rank) or runs (3+ suited sequence). On your turn, draw a card from stock, arrange your hand, and discard one card to pass. Knock when your unmatched cards (deadwood) total 10 or less.
openingNarration: Gin Rummy ready. Deal 10 cards each and form your melds.
